'''Yantahar Bwua'tu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served in the [[New Jedi Order]] in [[44 ABY]].

==Biography==
Yantahar Bwua'tu was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] relative of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], he had achieved the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] began falling prey to a [[Force psychosis]], causing tensions between the Order and the Galactic Alliance. Meanwhile, [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] encountered a [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]]. The [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] wanted to send [[StealthX]]s to help him, but interim Grand Master [[Kenth Hamner]] was opposed to the action, as he feared it would start a war between the Jedi and the Galactic Alliance. Hamner was eventually relieved from duty and confined to his quarters by the other [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]], who then set the plan to launch the StealthXs in motion.<ref name="Vortex" />

Bwua'tu, along with the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] Jedi [[Vaala Razelle]], was stationed outside of the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|hangar]]. Hamner escaped from his quarters and confronted Bwua'tu and Razelle, but they forbade him entry. Hamner claimed that allowing the StealthXs to launch was an act of [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the Galactic Alliance, and&mdash;upon discovering Bwua'tu's relation to Nek Bwua'tu&mdash;attempted to use his emotions about the Admiral's recent comatose state to make him lower his guard. Hamner then attacked the two Jedi, overpowering them and knocking them unconscious. Inside the hangar, he entered into a standoff with Master [[Saba Sebatyne]] when the Jedi refused to stop the launch, and in the [[Skirmish in the Operations Hangar|ensuing skirmish]], Hamner was [[Death/Legends|killed]] and the StealthXs were able to launch.<ref name="Vortex" />

Yantahar was part of the Jedi infiltration of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] takeover. He and [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]], a fellow [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] Jedi, were apprehended by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] soldiers when suspected of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]].
